freeze_policy: No dataset/expectation edits after first evaluation starts; no reruns/tuning.
construction: Deterministic frozen checker-first reference + PautaEngine; reference normalization manually specified before outcomes. No LLM judge or extractor in construction.

metrics.obligation_detection: eligible awards; effective supported obligations, including auxiliary IDs without points; micro TP/FP/FN
metrics.context_accuracy: No eligible support sourced from any specified rejected span; omission is safe suppression, explicit rejection reported separately.
metrics.conflict_accuracy: Expected IDs explicitly flagged unresolved AND not eligible; safe suppression without flag counted separately.
metrics.refutation_preservation: Expected negative ID has checker mathematical refutation, including subcheck FORMAL_REFUTED; absence not a refutation.
metrics.score: exact, mean absolute error, signed bias semantic minus expected, within1 inclusive, under/over counts and points
metrics.false_credit: positive excess score AND separately false-positive obligations; equal score may hide false support
metrics.verdict: ADVANTAGE if MAE strictly lower, exact noninferior, excess points nonincreasing, obligation precision noninferior, context and conflict accuracy noninferior; NONINFERIOR if same but MAE tied; otherwise REGRESSION. No significance claim.
